comment: First match wins, top to bottom. agent and error are regexes; error is matched against the NORMALISED error (lowercase, ids/numbers/times/paths replaced). owner is a post-office agent, 'eg' (a mail, no agent) or 'sender' (the caller's own alert board already has it). The last rule must match everything.

rules.name: account: session limit
rules.advice: The subscription ran out of usage; it resets by itself. If it keeps happening, the work needs to move to another account or be spread out.

rules.name: account: login
rules.error: login has expired|failed to authenticate|oauth|401|sign in again
rules.advice: Sign in again with `claude` on SQMC (ssh -p 2222 adamsl@100.102.209.100). No agent may renew a login.

rules.name: cli: too old
rules.error: does not support this model|claude update|or newer is required
rules.advice: Run `claude update` on SQMC; the CLI is older than the model needs.

rules.name: provider: stream disconnected
rules.error: stream disconnected|reconnecting|error sending request|connection reset|timed out connecting
rules.advice: The provider's connection dropped. If it repeats, check SQMC's internet/DNS and the provider's status page.

rules.name: guard: credentials withheld
rules.advice: The credential guard did its job. Check the request didn't ask for a secret.

rules.name: caller: workdir outside
rules.advice: The request named a workdir this agent may not use.

rules.name: needs a person: mechanic gave up
rules.advice: The mechanic could not repair it within its rules; read its run under adws/adw_data/mechanic/.

rules.name: config: unknown model
rules.error: model metadata|model is not supported|unknown model|model not found

rules.name: code: request refused by validation
rules.error: refused the request|validation error|not valid json
